SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Criminal Registry Station,
No. I. Q. D. 822.
Date December 27, 1929.
28/12/29）

File No.

Subject (in full) Arrival of Soviet Agents.

Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by Jhn Robertson, C.D.I.

The undermentioned persons recently arrived in Shanghai
from Tientsin and reside some where in the French Concession.
Efforts are being made to locate them.

All these persons were formerly White Russians and in
1925 turned over to the Bolsheviks in Tientsin when they
were attached to the G.P.U. through the medium of Comrade
Rivkin, Custodian of the Soviet Consulate there.

（批：See 04748）
John Tishevsky-
Member of the G.P.U. attached
to the Soviet Consulate in
Tientsin. Was engaged as
chauffeur to the Soviet Consul.

（批：See 1.0
9541）
Valentin Strogonoff-
Member of the G.P.U. attached
to the Soviet Consulate in
Tientsin. Was engaged as
recruiting agent amongst White
Russians for the Bolshevik
Detachment of General Guschin
in Marshal Feng Yu-hsieng's
Army. He was also engaged as
a Soviet Spy in the White Russian
Detachment of General Nechaeff
in Marshal Chang Chung Chang's
Army.

（批：See 1.0.
9541）
Gerasim Popoff-
Member of the G.P.U. attached
to the Soviet Consulate in
Tientsin. Was engaged as
recruiting agent amongst White
Russians for the Bolshevik

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事登记站，
编号 I. Q. D. 822。
日期 1929 年 12 月 27 日。
28/12/29）

档案号

主题（全称）苏联特工抵沪。

由 D.S. Maklaevsky 撰写。由刑事调查主任 Jhn Robertson 转呈。

下列人员最近从天津抵达上海，现居住于法租界某处。正设法查明其具体住址。

上述人员原均为白俄，1925 年在天津通过当时苏联领事馆保管员里夫金同志（Comrade Rivkin）的中介，被移交给布尔什维克，并隶属于国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）。

（批注：见 04748）
约翰·季舍夫斯基 (John Tishevsky)-
隶属于天津苏联领事馆的国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）成员。受雇担任苏联领事的司机。

（批注：见 1.0
9541）
瓦伦丁·斯特罗戈诺夫 (Valentin Strogonoff)-
隶属于天津苏联领事馆的国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）成员。受雇在冯玉祥元帅麾下古辛将军（General Guschin）的布尔什维克分队中，在白俄群体间从事招募工作。他还曾在张宗昌元帅麾下涅恰耶夫将军（General Nechaeff）的白俄分队中担任苏联间谍。

（批注：见 1.0.
9541）
格拉西姆·波波夫 (Gerasim Popoff)-
隶属于天津苏联领事馆的国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）成员。受雇在冯玉祥
